summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting across login  ### What I found (read-only audit, no changes made) The wiring is actually correct end-to-end, which changes the nature of this ticket: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/guest fallback — it always calls the API (`GET /watchlist`, `POST /watchlist/:id/items`, etc.) with no default/guest watchlist id anywhere in the client. - `client/src/lib/api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"`, so the session cookie is attached to every request. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` applies its own `router.use("*", ...)` auth middlewa
